summary: Full E2E backend + frontend testing of the new Educational Deep Dive product. Backend: 16/16 unit tests (test_edu_deep.py) and 9/9 new live E2E tests (test_edu_deep_live.py) pass. SNC v2 regression suite: 79 passed, 1 skipped. Frontend: /special-needs-v2/educational-deep-dive renders with edu-deep-root, 12 progress dot pattern (visible sections only), sticky prev/save/next nav all present. Selecting TX in s1_school_state reveals goto-s3 dot; switching to CA hides it. Report page renders with edu-deep-report-root + edu-deep-report-download testids and correct summary (5 flagged, 1 strength). Guest requests to /api/edu-deep/report/generate correctly blocked. PDF endpoint returns %PDF, > 5000 bytes, application/pdf. All spec requirements met. Test data cleaned via DELETE /api/edu-deep/me.

minor.issue: Spec description says summary.flagged_sections/strength_sections are 'arrays' but implementation returns int counters (arrays live under flagged_names/strength_names). Not a bug — both counters and name arrays exist. Update spec wording OR alias arrays.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='snc2-edu-deep-dive-cta' and 'snc2-edu-deep-dive-cta-link' live INSIDE the child-picker block. For a returning user who already has an active assessment (like parent1) the picker isn't shown, so the CTA card + link are not rendered. The persistent top-toolbar link data-testid='snc2-open-edu-deep-dive' IS shown, so the deep dive is still reachable, but the spec's exact testids fail for returning users.

design_issues.screen: Educational Deep Dive assessment page + Report page
issues: The LegalAcknowledgment modal (z-1000) reappears on every route inside /special-needs-v2/* including /educational-deep-dive and /educational-deep-dive/report. It doesn't intercept once dismissed, but returning users see it on every visit — verify it stays dismissed after acknowledgment (may be intended).

action_items: Move the snc2-edu-deep-dive-cta card OUT of the child-picker conditional block on /special-needs-v2 so returning users also see the CTA card+link with the exact testids from the spec.
OPTIONAL: rename summary.flagged_sections/strength_sections to _count and expose flagged_sections/strength_sections as the arrays (or update the review-request wording).
critical_code_review_comments: edu_deep_report.py uses several deprecated fpdf2 kwargs (ln=1, dest='S'). Migrate to new_x=XPos.LMARGIN/new_y=YPos.NEXT and pdf.output() without dest.

Frontend SingleRow/MultiRow chips do not carry per-option data-testid — the state chip container has a testid but individual state buttons don't. Adding data-testid={testid}-{opt} on each option button would make E2E testing dramatically more reliable.
Legal acknowledgment modal blocks Playwright pointer events on every entry to the deep-dive route; storing acknowledgment in localStorage keyed per-user could avoid re-prompting once accepted.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (CTA testids missing for returning users; all deep-dive UI + report UI work)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted (via DELETE /api/edu-deep/me) a full TX+IEP filled assessment + generated report for parent1. Final state: clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes are stable. Frontend E2E must (1) log in as parent1, (2) dismiss the LegalAcknowledgment modal via data-testid='legal-ack-checkbox' + 'legal-ack-continue-button' BEFORE interacting with the deep dive. State chip options don't have individual testids — click by button text inside container [data-testid='edu-deep-s1_school_state']. Report page only renders edu-deep-report-root once a report has been generated via /api/edu-deep/report/generate.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues. Only spec-vs-implementation naming mismatch (flagged_sections int vs array) and a conditional-rendering scope for the snc2-edu-deep-dive-cta testids.
